title: One Cell to Many: Cell Division
summary: New cells come from old cells. Doubling, growth and repair, and why bacteria in food multiply so fast.

ib.note: Mitosis and meiosis are formalised in MYP 5 / CBSE 10

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: The Invisible Living World: Beyond Our Naked Eye

objectives: I can explain that new cells are made when existing cells divide.
I can calculate the number of cells after several divisions.
I can apply cell division to growth, repair and food safety.
misconceptions: Cells grow bigger and bigger instead of dividing.
New cells can appear from nothing.
Bacteria in food are harmless if you can't see them.
